gloss: good catch; bumper haul; abundant fishing

definitions.gloss: good catch; bumper haul; abundant fishing
definitions.explanation: An especially large or plentiful fish catch. Used for both a single outing's results and a season's overall yield.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{豊漁|ほうりょう}だ。
examples.english: It's a good catch this year.

examples.japanese: サンマ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{豊漁|ほうりょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: Saury prices dropped because of the abundant catch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{漁師|りょうし}→漁師：21205_ryoushi⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{豊漁|ほうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}って→祈る：01198_inoru⟧⟦{出港|しゅっこう}→出港：11764_shukkou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The fishermen set out to sea praying for a bountiful catch.

notes:
A compound of {豊|ほう} (abundant, rich) and {漁|りょう} (fishing, catch). The antonym is {不漁|ふりょう} (poor catch). Commonly seen in seasonal news reports about fish catches.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {豊漁|ほうりょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{恵|めぐ}まれる→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧: to be blessed with a good catch
- {豊漁|ほうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧: to pray for an abundant catch
- ⟦{記録的|きろくてき}→記録的：28788_kirokuteki⟧な{豊漁|ほうりょう}: a record-breaking catch
- {豊漁|ほうりょう}⟦{貧乏|びんぼう}→貧乏：19466_binbou⟧: poverty due to an oversupply of fish (prices crash so fishermen lose money despite catching more)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大漁|たいりょう}: big catch — more casual and celebratory; often seen on fishing flags ({大漁旗|たいりょうばた})
- {不漁|ふりょう}: poor catch — the antonym
- ⟦{豊作|ほうさく}→豊作：14227_housaku⟧: bumper crop — the agricultural equivalent (for farming, not fishing)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{豊漁|ほうりょう}⟦{貧乏|びんぼう}→貧乏：19466_binbou⟧ is a well-known economic paradox in Japan: when the catch is too good, fish prices plummet and fishermen's income actually decreases despite the abundance.
